{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values in the 'baseline_biomarker' column
missing_baseline = df['baseline_biomarker'].isnull().sum()

# Check the data type and distribution of the column
dtype_baseline = df['baseline_biomarker'].dtype
mean_baseline = df['baseline_biomarker'].mean()

# Return the results
(missing_baseline, dtype_baseline, mean_baseline)"}
